_help: Fox Drop live events. Use "start" (UTC, e.g. 2026-10-31T18:00:00Z) when the time is known, or "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) when only the day is. Add "end" (UTC) for something that lasts, like a Power Hour: it stays live and counts down to the end, with a 15-minutes-left alert. Each id must be unique; changing an event's time sends a 'new time' alert. Past events drop off by themselves.

events.title: Birthday Power Hour #1
events.note: Runs 2-5 PM ET. Everyone drops with Presents, the Exotic Balloon Popper AR is in the wild, the Birthday Sprites (all 5 variants) arrive, and chests can drop 1-Up Tokens and Portable Extractors.

events.title: Birthday Power Hour #2
events.note: Runs 9 PM-midnight ET. Everyone drops with Presents, the Exotic Balloon Popper AR is in the wild, the Birthday Sprites (all 5 variants) arrive, and chests can drop 1-Up Tokens and Portable Extractors.
